title: A goal research worker's alias rows reach the kb, though a research item's touches may never name _tools/aliases.csv
goal: The kb-research skill, run as a sprint's goal research worker (a research item whose touches lie inside one kb root, never _tools/), says where the alias rows for a new topic's other names go so they land: a per-root aliases file under the root's _retrieval/ that rag.py reads, or a follow-up item the worker files with the rows. SP-qjn563cf: ST-pnr4zyni wrote 48 alias rows for 14 new topics, found _tools/aliases.csv outside its touches, restored it and left the rows in scratch; ST-zrysu6ri carries them.

run: import sys;t=open('.claude/skills/kb-research/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();sys.exit(0 if 'aliases.csv' in t and 'research item' in t else 1)
